name: Polyglycitol Syrup
aliases: E964, INS 964, polyglycitol syrup, hydrogenated starch hydrolysate, hydrogenated glucose syrup, polyglucitol
what_is: A hydrogenated starch-hydrolysate mixture consisting mainly of maltitol and sorbitol, with smaller amounts of hydrogenated oligo- and polysaccharides; it is authorised in the EU as food additive E964.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because E964 is a sweetening ingredient that can also function as a bulking agent, stabiliser, texturiser or thickener, and it may appear under official synonyms such as hydrogenated starch hydrolysate.
can_1: Identify E964, polyglycitol syrup and official synonyms including hydrogenated starch hydrolysate and polyglucitol.
can_2: Trigger the sweetener, texture and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount present or the precise proportions of its component polyols from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_2: Predict an individual's digestive response or the product's overall metabolic effect from this ingredient alone.

sources.label: Commission Regulation (EU) No 1050/2012 — E964 polyglycitol syrup specifications and synonyms

title: Polyglycitol Syrup
description: A hydrogenated starch-hydrolysate polyol mixture used as food additive E964 and as a sweetener and texturising ingredient.
